correctness.rationale: For q congruent 1 mod 3, cubic Gauss sums yield |S(u)| <= (1+2 sqrt q)/3 at every nonzero u. Fourier inversion counts unrestricted ordered triples, and at most 3h triples violate coordinate distinctness. The resulting explicit lower bound is >0 for sqrt q>=13; direct finite-field full enumeration checks all 24 eligible prime powers smaller than 169 and all target fibers, using the included actual standalone code.
